keywords.title: Search keywords
keywords.description: What you sell, one search per keyword (results merged and deduplicated). Example: software development, medical equipment, road construction, consulting.

countries.title: Countries (optional)
countries.description: Restrict results by country. Use ISO 3-letter codes for EU tenders (DEU, FRA, ESP, ITA, POL) or country names for World Bank tenders (Kenya, Brazil, India). Empty = everywhere.

publishedWithinDays.title: Published within (days)
publishedWithinDays.description: Only return tenders published in the last N days.

activeOnly.title: Open tenders only
activeOnly.description: Drop tenders whose submission deadline has already passed.

maxTenders.title: Max tenders per run
maxTenders.description: Cap on tender rows returned. Controls total cost.

dedupe.title: Skip tenders seen in previous runs
dedupe.description: Remember returned tender IDs across runs and skip them. Turn on for scheduled new-tender alerts.
